quest.title: The Vishaps Lie Dormant, but the Enigma Lingers Still
quest.description: After a sustained effort, you seem to have scared the Geovishaps into submission and the disturbances across the land seem to have subsided. However, the reason for their re-emergence and rampage remains a mystery...

talks.objective: Talk to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Adventurer, thanks to your hard work, the Geovishap investigation can be brought to a close.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for alleviating the pressure on the Guild.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: All the adventurers who took leave to visit their families have now returned and reported in at the Guild. You have already made a great contribution, so please, leave the remaining work to us.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: As for why these ancient creatures suddenly began appearing, we will continue to investigate.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Oh, and don't forget to claim your investigation rewards.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Adventurers' Guild looks forward to your continued excellence! Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: Aw, I was just getting started.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Haha, it seems like you enjoyed yourself, then. That's wonderful.
